column1: # Unimod cross-references for UniProt modifications that UniProt's ptmlist.txt does not link to Unimod.
# Columns: UniProt PTM accession <TAB> Unimod record id <TAB> UniProt name <TAB> Unimod title.
# Only the first two columns are read; the names are for review.
# ModificationLoader adds "Unimod; <id>" to a modification whose AC is listed here, when the entry has no
# Unimod cross-reference of its own. UniProt's own link always wins, so if a later ptmlist release adds
# one, this row stops having any effect and can be deleted.
# A row is added only when the Unimod record is the same modification: its composition equals the formula
# mzLib holds for the UniProt entry (after the PSI-MOD formal-charge correction), the residue is one of its
# sites, and the chemistry is the same. A record that merely shares the formula (an isomer, an amino-acid
# substitution, an unrelated adduct) is not a cross-reference. ModificationTest checks the first two rules.
